# Async Parallel Random Walks

This vignette provides a **fully interactive Shiny application** demonstrating async parallel random walk simulations running directly in your browser using WebAssembly.

> **Note:** This demonstrates **Issue #129** - mirai-based async support for WebAssembly! The randomwalk package auto-detects your environment and selects the appropriate backend:
>
> - **WebR/Browser:** Uses `mirai` backend with `nanonext` from r-lib.r-universe.dev
> - **Native R:** Uses `crew` backend
>
> Both environments support `workers=2` for true async parallel processing!

## Interactive Dashboard

```{shinylive-r}
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 900

# ============================================================================
# Package Installation with nanonext from r-lib.r-universe.dev
# ============================================================================

cat("\n=== ASYNC PARALLEL SETUP (dynamic_broadcasting.qmd) ===\n")
cat("Timestamp:", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "\n\n")

cat("Installing randomwalk...\n")
cat("Note: Async mode requires webR with R 4.5.1+ (includes nanonext support)\n\n")
tryCatch({
  webr::install(
    "randomwalk",
    repos = c(
      "https://johngavin.github.io/randomwalk",  # Fast: GitHub Pages WASM repo (5-10 min)
      "https://johngavin.r-universe.dev",        # Fallback: R-Universe (1-5 hours)
      "https://repo.r-wasm.org"                  # Standard webR packages
    )
  )
  cat("✅ randomwalk installed\n")
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("❌ ERROR installing randomwalk:", e$message, "\n")
})

cat("\nInstalling/loading required packages...\n")
# shiny is usually pre-installed in webR, but load it explicitly
library(shiny)
cat("✅ shiny loaded\n")

# Install ggplot2 dependencies and ggplot2
tryCatch({
  library(ggplot2)
  cat("✅ ggplot2 loaded\n")
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("⚠️  ggplot2 not found, installing dependencies...\n")
  # Install munsell first (required ggplot2 dependency)
  webr::install("munsell", repos = "https://repo.r-wasm.org")
  cat("✅ munsell installed\n")
  # Now install ggplot2
  webr::install("ggplot2", repos = "https://repo.r-wasm.org")
  library(ggplot2)
  cat("✅ ggplot2 installed and loaded\n")
})

# Install mirai for async parallel processing in WebR
tryCatch({
  library(mirai)
  cat("✅ mirai loaded\n")
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("⚠️  mirai not found, installing from r-lib.r-universe.dev...\n")
  webr::install("mirai", repos = "https://r-lib.r-universe.dev")
  library(mirai)
  cat("✅ mirai installed and loaded\n")
})

tryCatch({
  library(randomwalk)
  cat("✅ randomwalk loaded\n")
  cat("Available functions:", paste(head(ls("package:randomwalk"), 10), collapse=", "), "\n")
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("❌ ERROR loading randomwalk:", e$message, "\n")
  cat("Packages available:\n")
  print(installed.packages()[, c("Package", "Version")])
})

cat("\n=== SETUP COMPLETE ===\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# Shiny UI
# ============================================================================

ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Async Parallel Random Walks (Issue #129 ✅)"),

  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      h4("Simulation Parameters"),

      sliderInput("grid_size", "Grid Size:",
                  min = 10, max = 50, value = 20, step = 5),

      sliderInput("n_walkers", "Number of Walkers:",
                  min = 1, max = 20, value = 5, step = 1),

      sliderInput("workers", "Parallel Workers (0=sync, 2-4=async):",
                  min = 0, max = 4, value = 2, step = 1),

      selectInput("neighborhood", "Neighborhood:",
                  choices = c("4-hood", "8-hood"),
                  selected = "4-hood"),

      selectInput("boundary", "Boundary Behavior:",
                  choices = c("terminate", "wrap"),
                  selected = "terminate"),

      sliderInput("max_steps", "Max Steps per Walker:",
                  min = 100, max = 10000, value = 5000, step = 100),

      actionButton("run_sim", "Run Simulation",
                   class = "btn-primary btn-lg"),

      hr(),

      h5("Status:"),
      verbatimTextOutput("status")
    ),

    mainPanel(
      tabsetPanel(
        id = "tabs",

        tabPanel("Grid",
                 plotOutput("grid_plot", height = "600px")),

        tabPanel("Walker Paths",
                 plotOutput("paths_plot", height = "600px")),

        tabPanel("Statistics",
                 h4("Simulation Statistics"),
                 verbatimTextOutput("stats_text"),
                 hr(),
                 h5("Backend Information"),
                 verbatimTextOutput("backend_info"))
      )
    )
  )
)

# ============================================================================
# Shiny Server
# ============================================================================

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  # Reactive value to store simulation result
  sim_result <- reactiveVal(NULL)

  # Run simulation when button clicked
  observeEvent(input$run_sim, {
    output$status <- renderText({
      paste0(
        "Running simulation...\n",
        "Grid: ", input$grid_size, "×", input$grid_size, "\n",
        "Walkers: ", input$n_walkers, "\n",
        "Workers: ", input$workers,
        if (input$workers > 0) " (async)" else " (sync)"
      )
    })

    tryCatch({
      # Run simulation with async support
      result <- run_simulation(
        grid_size = input$grid_size,
        n_walkers = input$n_walkers,
        neighborhood = input$neighborhood,
        boundary = input$boundary,
        max_steps = input$max_steps,
        workers = input$workers,  # Auto-detects backend (mirai in WebR)
        sync_mode = "static",     # Grid snapshots (dynamic is Issue #130)
        verbose = FALSE
      )

      sim_result(result)

      output$status <- renderText({
        paste0(
          "✅ Simulation complete!\n",
          "Elapsed time: ", sprintf("%.2f", result$statistics$elapsed_time_secs), "s\n",
          "Backend: ", if (input$workers > 0) "mirai" else "synchronous"
        )
      })

    }, error = function(e) {
      output$status <- renderText({
        paste0("❌ ERROR:\n", e$message)
      })
    })
  })

  # Grid plot
  output$grid_plot <- renderPlot({
    req(sim_result())
    plot_grid(sim_result(), main = "Final Grid State")
  })

  # Walker paths plot
  output$paths_plot <- renderPlot({
    req(sim_result())
    plot_walker_paths(sim_result())
  })

  # Statistics text
  output$stats_text <- renderText({
    req(sim_result())
    stats <- sim_result()$statistics

    paste0(
      "Grid Size: ", stats$grid_size, "×", stats$grid_size, "\n",
      "Black Pixels: ", stats$black_pixels,
      sprintf(" (%.2f%%)\n", stats$black_percentage),
      "\nWalkers:\n",
      "  Total: ", stats$total_walkers, "\n",
      "  Completed: ", stats$completed_walkers, "\n",
      "\nSteps:\n",
      "  Total: ", stats$total_steps, "\n",
      "  Min: ", stats$min_steps, "\n",
      "  Max: ", stats$max_steps, "\n",
      "  Mean: ", sprintf("%.1f", stats$mean_steps), "\n",
      "  Median: ", stats$median_steps, "\n",
      "\nPerformance:\n",
      "  Elapsed Time: ", sprintf("%.2f", stats$elapsed_time_secs), "s\n",
      "\nTermination Reasons:\n",
      paste(sprintf("  %s: %d", names(stats$termination_reasons),
                    stats$termination_reasons), collapse = "\n")
    )
  })

  # Backend information
  output$backend_info <- renderText({
    is_webr <- exists(".webr_env", envir = .GlobalEnv) ||
               identical(Sys.getenv("WEBR"), "1")

    paste0(
      "Environment: ", if (is_webr) "WebR/Browser" else "Native R", "\n",
      "Backend: ", if (input$workers > 0) {
        if (is_webr) "mirai (WebAssembly-compatible)" else "crew"
      } else {
        "synchronous (no parallelization)"
      }, "\n",
      "\nPackage Versions:\n",
      "  randomwalk: ", packageVersion("randomwalk"), "\n",
      if (requireNamespace("mirai", quietly = TRUE)) {
        paste0("  mirai: ", packageVersion("mirai"), "\n")
      } else "",
      if (requireNamespace("nanonext", quietly = TRUE)) {
        paste0("  nanonext: ", packageVersion("nanonext"), "\n")
      } else "",
      if (requireNamespace("crew", quietly = TRUE)) {
        paste0("  crew: ", packageVersion("crew"), "\n")
      } else "",
      "\nIssue #129: ✅ Async parallel support in WebAssembly\n",
      "Issue #130: ⏳ Dynamic broadcasting (future work)"
    )
  })
}

# ============================================================================
# Run Shiny App
# ============================================================================

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```

## Features

This dashboard demonstrates:

1. **Auto-backend Selection**: Automatically uses mirai in WebR, crew in native R
2. **True Async Parallelization**: Workers > 0 enables parallel processing in browser!
3. **Real-time Visualization**: Grid state, walker paths, and statistics
4. **Parameter Tuning**: Adjust simulation parameters interactively

## Technical Details

### Package Sources

- **randomwalk**: https://johngavin.github.io/randomwalk/
- **nanonext & mirai**: https://r-lib.r-universe.dev

### Backend Selection (Issue #129 ✅)

**In WebR/Browser:**
- Uses `mirai` backend for async parallelization
- `nanonext` package from r-lib.r-universe.dev
- All computation happens client-side

**In Native R:**
- Uses `crew` backend (preferred for better abstractions)
- `crew` internally uses `mirai`

### Sync Modes

- **`sync_mode="static"`**: Workers get grid snapshots (current, used in WebR)
- **`sync_mode="dynamic"`**: Real-time broadcasting via nanonext (Issue #130, future work)

## Try It Yourself

Experiment with different parameters:

- **Larger grid**: More exploration space (try 30 or 40)
- **More walkers**: Increase density (try 10 or 15)
- **More workers**: Increase parallelization (try 4)
- **8-hood**: Enable diagonal movement
- **Wrap boundary**: Toroidal grid (no boundaries)
